title: Block Definition
description: Schema for a platform block's block.json definition file.

id.description: Unique block identifier. Must match the directory name under blocks/. Lowercase, hyphens only.

version.description: SemVer version string. Graphs pin this version — bump when changing ports or behavior.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown on the canvas block card and palette. Supervisor-facing.

category.description: Used to group blocks in the palette. 'arm' is reserved for split arm blocks.

hardware_family.description: Optional. Blocks in the same hardware_family share port interfaces and are grouped in the palette. Camera blocks all output image_frame; arm blocks all use the joint_state/ee_pose/motion_id/gripper_cmd port set.

icon.description: Icon name from the platform icon set. Used on the block card. Defaults to the category name if absent.

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile relative to the block directory. Defaults to './Dockerfile'.

image_ref.description: Override the Docker image reference. If omitted, the platform builds the image from the Dockerfile and tags it host-gateway:5000/{id}:{version}.

hardware_detection_hint.description: If set, the platform shows a green dot on this block's palette card when matching hardware is detected.

requires_gpu.description: If true, adds 'deploy.resources.reservations.devices' for NVIDIA GPU in the generated compose.

ports.description: Typed input and output ports. Wires can only connect ports with matching aliases.

supervisor_params.description: Parameters shown on the block card. Supervisors can edit these without engineer involvement.

engineer_params.description: Parameters hidden behind 'Advanced' toggle. Exposed only to engineers (requires engineer PIN).

presets_endpoint.description: If true, the platform queries GET /presets on this block's container to populate dropdown options. Required for all arm-motion blocks.

id.description: Port identifier. Used internally for topic remapping. Must be unique within this block's ports.

alias.description: User-facing port type alias. Canvas enforces alias matching — supervisors never see ROS2 types.

ros2_type.description: The ROS2 message type published or subscribed on this port. Used by the launch engine for topic validation.

label.description: Human-readable port label shown on the block card connector.

optional.description: If true, the port does not need to be wired for Run to proceed.

id.description: Parameter identifier. Passed to the container as an environment variable: PARAM_{ID} (uppercased).

label.description: Human-readable label shown next to the input field on the block card.

default.description: Default value. Must match the declared type.

options.description: Required for type: 'enum'. The selectable values.

units.description: Optional unit suffix shown in the UI (e.g. 'fps', 'ms', '%').

min.description: Minimum value for int/float params. UI clamps to this range.
